source_text: Pontifex sumit de sanguine et infert intra velamen. Solus Christus intrat vera sancta.
pass_a_gloss: High-priest takes of blood and carries-in within veil. Alone Christ enters true holy-places.
pass_b_english: The high priest [[takes blood and enters within the veil >> Bible:Leviticus 16:15]]. Christ alone enters the true holy places.
